第一章：【脑子寄存，放松一下。】

十里坡。

破旧山神庙前。

“师父……这真的是咱们天下第一仙宗的山门吗？”

漆黑长发被一根红绳扎住的仙气少女，抬眼看着面前破庙，神情欲言又止。

穿着破旧道袍的年轻男子回过头，看向自己好不容易忽悠来的仙苗。

楚星尘英俊帅气的脸露出些许高人风范道：“山不在高，有仙则名。”

“你年纪还小，莫要着了相。”

穿着粉红色流仙裙的少女露出恍然大悟的神色：

“我明白了师父！其实里面是不是内有乾坤？！”

“我看祁山修仙传里面就是这样写的，一扇破门

李应灵神色兴奋的一路小跑，满脸兴奋的推开破旧漏风的大门。

满眼期待着里面的内有乾坤。

随后映入眼帘的却是……

被毁坏只剩半截的神像，悬梁上的蜘蛛网都还没扫干净。

原先的供桌被搬到了一张破木板前，看起来是被当做书桌使用。

但这供桌还歪了一角，被人用一块石头垫好。

一旁还有用石头简单堆砌成的灶台，上面还有一个小小的铁锅。

李应灵觉得这就是一个破旧无人参拜的破旧神像。

而且还像是乞丐住的！

楚星尘也迈步走进破庙，神色淡然一点不觉尴尬道：

“以后不要看那些凡夫俗子写的话本了，容易把脑子看坏。”

“等等师父把神像的侧面木板给你拆下来当床，这神庙有点大，你想睡那都可以。”

李应灵只觉得眼前一黑，怯怯问道：

“师父……修仙不是这样的吧？”

楚星尘信誓旦旦道：“修仙！就是这样的！”

李应灵怯怯的问道：“可别的仙门不都是金碧辉煌，什么高耸如云的山峰之上悬浮着浩瀚宫殿吗？”

“你亲眼见过，还是听哪位道友说的？”

“话本里……不都是这么说的吗？”

“你也知道是话本，现在修仙都不讲这个，只要能修成仙，那就是修的一手好仙。”

楚星尘抓住重点道：“凡夫俗子那些人懂什么修仙，知道什么是大道至简吗？”

李应灵闻言弱弱道：“但……但这也太简了吧。”

“少说废话，你修不修吧。”

“……修。”

楚星尘坐到木板上，轻咳一声，露出些许笑容道：

“那还不快来磕头拜师？”

李应灵闻言，似乎有些不情不愿的挪动脚步。

但如今也没有回头路了。

Chapter 1: [Stop your brain and relax.】

Ten miles of slope.

In front of the dilapidated mountain temple.

"Master...is this really the gate of our No. 1 Immortal Sect in the world?"

The fairy-like girl with long black hair tied by a red rope looked up at the ruined temple in front of her, her expression wanting to speak but stopping.

The young man wearing a worn-out robe turned back and looked at the fairy seedlings that he had finally deceived.

Chu Xingchen's handsome face showed a hint of a master's demeanor and said: "The mountain is not high, as long as there are immortals, it is famous."

"You are still young, so don't get confused."

The girl wearing a pink fairy skirt showed a look of realization:

"I understand, Master! In fact, is there a universe inside?!"

"I read that this is what is written in Qishan's Legend of Immortality, a broken door

Li Yingling trotted all the way with excitement, and pushed open the old and leaky door with excitement.

Looking forward to the universe inside.

What came into view next was...

Only half of the statue was destroyed, and the spider webs on the hanging beams had not yet been swept away.

The original altar table was moved to a broken wooden board and seemed to be used as a desk.

But the altar table was still tilted at one corner, so someone used a stone to cushion it.

Next to it is a stove made of simple stones, with a small iron pot on it.

Li Yingling felt that this was a dilapidated and dilapidated statue that no one worshiped.

And it looks like a beggar’s place!

Chu Xingchen also stepped into the ruined temple, with a calm expression and said without feeling embarrassed:

"In the future, don't read those storybooks written by ordinary people, as they can easily damage your mind."

"Wait a while for Master to remove the side planks of the statue for you to use as a bed. This temple is a bit big, you can sleep there if you want."

Li Yingling felt her eyes go dark and asked timidly:

"Master... isn't this how cultivating an immortal is?"

Chu Xingchen vowed: "Cultivation to immortality!That's it!"

Li Yingling asked timidly: "But aren't the other immortal sects all magnificent and magnificent, with vast palaces suspended on top of towering mountain peaks like clouds?"

"Did you see it with your own eyes, or did you hear it from a fellow Taoist?"

"Isn't that what the storybooks say..."

"You also know that it is a fairy tale. Nowadays, cultivating immortals does not talk about this. As long as you can cultivate to become an immortal, you are a good immortal."

Chu Xingchen grasped the key point and said: "Do those ordinary people know what it is to cultivate immortality, and do they know what the great simplicity is?"

Li Yingling heard this and said weakly: "But...but this is too simple."

“Stop talking nonsense, it’s up to you to cultivate or not."

"……build."

Chu Xingchen sat on the wooden board, coughed slightly, showed a slight smile and said:

"Then why don't you come and kowtow to become your master?"

When Li Yingling heard this, he seemed to move reluctantly.

But now there is no turning back.
